takeaway: Breathlessness with swelling of the face, neck and arms, distended jugular veins and dilated chest-wall collaterals is superior vena cava syndrome, from external compression and obstruction of the SVC.

layers.text: 1 · A mass squeezes the vena cava
2 · Blood backs up from the head
